observations: Photo 0 shows a split air conditioner removed from the wall: the indoor unit rests on top of the outdoor unit on a tiled floor.
Photo 0: the outdoor unit's front panel carries a red 'SANYO' logo, partly faded, and the word 'inverter' below it.
Photo 0: the indoor unit has small printed labels on its front, including an energy or rating sticker; the model and capacity on them are not legible.
Photo 0: both units are yellowed and dirty, with scuffs and rust spots on the outdoor casing, consistent with years of use, not a unit bought last year.
Photo 0: the indoor unit louvre is open; a short cable hangs from the side of the outdoor unit; no pipes, remote control or mounting kit are shown.
No photo of the rating plates, the compressor, the units running, a receipt or a warranty card.

identity.kind: inverter split air conditioner (indoor and outdoor units)
read_from: photo 0 outdoor unit front panel 'SANYO' and 'inverter'

claims.evidence: Seller's own title; it is the worst case and nothing in photo 0 shows it running.
The seller's own advert says the AC is faulty; no clip of it cooling is shown.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows heavy yellowing, dirt, scuffs and rust on both units, the wear of many years of use.
No photo of the compressor or the inside of the outdoor unit.
Location cannot be shown by the photo.

risks.risk: The unit is faulty by the seller's own words; the fault may be the compressor or the inverter board, leaving it worth parts only.
risks.proof: Clip of the AC switched on, the outdoor fan and compressor running, and cold air measured at the indoor vent.

risks.risk: Capacity (horsepower) unknown, which changes the value of the unit.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rating plate on the side of the outdoor unit and on the indoor unit.
risks.if_unproven: as the smallest capacity split unit

risks.risk: Refrigerant gas may be lost and copper pipes, remote and accessories missing.
risks.proof: Photo of the service valves, pipes, remote and all included accessories laid out.
risks.if_unproven: as without gas, pipes or remote

risks.risk: Receipt and warranty may not exist or not match this unit.
risks.proof: Photo of the receipt and warranty card next to the rating plate serial number.
risks.if_unproven: as with no receipt or warranty

proof_requests: Clip of the AC running and cooling, outdoor compressor and fan in shot
Close-up of the rating plates on both units showing model and capacity
Photo of the receipt and warranty card beside the serial number plate
Photo of the pipes, remote and accessories included
Photo of the compressor and the inside of the outdoor unit
response.reason: The photo shows a Sanyo inverter split AC, read off the outdoor unit, and the seller calls it faulty, so it is priced at its worst case as a faulty unit of the smallest capacity. The 'no fault' and 'bought new last year' claims contradict the seller's own title and the visible wear, so they cannot raise the price.
